system.longDesc: You can fight more effectively wielding a single-handed melee weapon.

degree0.desc: Fighting with a single-handed weapon demands increased awareness. If you take the Activate action, you gain a +1 Defense bonus until the end of the encounter while fighting in this style.

degree1.desc: You can wield your weapon to block and parry attacks. Your bonus to Defense increases to +2 while fighting in this style.

degree2.desc: You know how to fight several enemies at once. Opponents making melee attacks against you never gain a bonus on their attack rolls for outnumbering you.
